I can't give you that count, because I can't search or open the emails in your mailbox from here.

- All I know about the mailbox is its overall size and range: 6,020 emails from 1997-03-03 to 2001-12-30.
- I have no tally of messages that mention LJM, so any number I gave would be a guess.
- LJM was the Fastow-run partnership entity (LJM Cayman and LJM2 Co-Investment), so mentions would most likely fall in the late-1999 to 2001 part of your mailbox. That is only a general expectation, not something I've checked.

To get a real number, run a search for "LJM" in your mail client and check the result count. Searching "LJM2" and "LJM Cayman" separately will catch variants. Searches usually also match subject lines and attachments differently, so the count may change depending on where you search.
